newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-IVERSEN COMPLETES MOVE TO TOTTENHAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVERSEN COMPLETES MOVE TO TOTTENHAM.

text.p: Premier league Tottenham completed the signing of striker Steffen Iversen from Norwegian champions Rosenborg on Monday.
The 20-year-old Iversen, who has signed a five-year contract, will cost Spurs around 2.6million pounds ($4.38).
He will travel to London on Thursday to undergo a medical, the club said.
Iversen is expected to make his final appearance for Rosenborg against AC Milan in the European Cup Champions' League on Wednesday.
